title: Durian Satay
description: A unique twist on traditional Japanese satay, featuring the infamous durian fruit.
instructions: 1. Cut the durian into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
2. Grill or pan-fry the satay meat until cooked through.
3. In a small saucepan, combine the satay sauce, coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Heat over low heat until warm and fragrant.
4. Add the grilled satay meat to the sauce and toss to coat.
5. If using, drizzle with oozy sauce for added creaminess.
6. Serve the satay with a side of cooked rice and garnish with chopped cilantro.
7. Squeeze a sliver of lime juice over the top for added brightness.
8. Enjoy with the durian pieces on the side or mixed into the satay sauce.
9. Garnish with additional cilantro and serve immediately.
